name: haus-co-platform
description: Haus & Co — All-in-one digital home construction platform for Sri Lanka

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,amber "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=shared && npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
